**Filed #842: tmp fixture leak mechanism (ENOSPC turned suite red)**

**What**: Issue #842 filed — /tmp fixture leak: 6686 orphaned dirs (11G) caused ENOSPC and a red suite with zero code changes during PR #841 round-2 verification.

**Why**: User: "necesitamos un mecanismo de limpieza" after the ENOSPC diagnosis.

**Where**: brain/scripts/vcs/release-postmerge-workflows.test.mjs:119 (runStepIsolated leaks pm-iso-* — 2180 per green run, no cleanup at all); brain-audit.test.mjs cleans via t.after but that dies with killed runs.

**Learned**: Two leak classes — helpers that never clean vs after() hooks that don't survive process death. Proposed: shared testTmp(prefix) helper under a per-run parent with process-exit sweep + pretest stale-run sweep (pid-dead detection). Awaiting status:approved.
